senses.gloss: m. (יָשָׁן) former condition, original usage (cmp. אֵיתָן).
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 19a:12">Snh. 19ᵃ</cite> <he>החזיר … הדבר ליוֹשְׁנוֹ</he> restored the usage to its original state; Y. ib. II, 20ᵃ bot.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 3:2:5">Y. Ber. III, 6ᵇ</cite> <he>חזרו הדברים ליוֹשְׁנָן</he>; <cite ref="Ketubot 8b:13">Keth. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>החזירו הדבר ליוֹשְׁנוֹ</he> (not <he>ליושנה</he>).
<cite ref="Kiddushin 66a:12">Kidd. 66ᵃ</cite> <he>עד שבא … והחזיר את התורה ליוֹשְׁנָהּ</he> until Simon b. Sh. came and restored the Law to its former authority.
<cite ref="Yoma 69b">Yoma 69ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="P00480"><he>עֲטָרָה</he></cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 7:3:9">Y. Ber. VII, 11ᶜ</cite>; a. e.
